title: Radon convergence of varifolds gives vague convergence of their weights on U
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^N. Let V_i (i ∈ ℕ) and V be n-varifolds on U (Varifold N n U) with V_i → V as Radon measures on G_n(U) (Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V). Then for every continuous g : ℝ^N → ℝ with compact support and tsupport g ⊆ U, the Bochner integrals of g against the weights converge: ∫ g dμ_{V_i} → ∫ g dμ_V as i → ∞, where μ_X = X.weight.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (Vi : ℕ → Varifold N n U) (V : Varifold N n U), Varifold.RadonConverges Vi V → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, g x ∂(Vi i).weight) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂V.weight))
